surfaces.name: Cloudflare Dynamic Web Frontend
surfaces.role: Public HQ, games, studio, worlds, safety, commerce, payload and integration surfaces.
surfaces.activation: Cloudflare Worker controls the API boundary and ASSETS delivery for thelingolegacy.com.

surfaces.name: Flutter App Layer
surfaces.role: Mobile shells for Lingo ID, worlds, profile, XP, virtual wallet display, games, commerce and settings.
surfaces.activation: Connect only after Firebase Auth, App Check, security rules, consent and mobile release evidence pass.

surfaces.name: Firebase App Backend
surfaces.role: Auth, App Check, Firestore, Storage, FCM, Crashlytics, Analytics and Remote Config where approved.
surfaces.activation: No Firebase writes are certified until a real project, rules, credentials and executable deployment evidence exist.

surfaces.name: Cloudflare Edge and Runtime
surfaces.role: Canonical DNS, Worker API boundary, asset delivery, security headers and observability.
surfaces.activation: Canonical domain and Worker binding remain authoritative; DNS changes require verification.

surfaces.name: GitHub Source and CI Layer
surfaces.role: Canonical source, review, validation, release evidence and deployment trigger.
surfaces.activation: Hosted runner execution must produce verified evidence before promotion.

surfaces.name: AppDeploy Studio QA Surface
surfaces.role: Studio-grade preview, backend QA, responsive snapshots and deployment validation.
surfaces.activation: AppDeploy does not override the canonical GitHub and Cloudflare production boundary.

certification.rule: No verified evidence means no certification or activation.
